event.title: Lebanese Army Deploys in Zawtar al-Gharbiyeh Following Israeli Withdrawal
event.canonical_title: Lebanese Army Deploys in Zawtar al-Gharbiyeh Following Israeli Withdrawal
event.summary: The Lebanese army has begun deploying troops in a southern town as part of a US-brokered agreement following the withdrawal of Israeli forces from a small area of Lebanon. This marks the first test of the deal aimed at stabilizing the region after recent conflicts with Hezbollah.

timeline.title: Lebanese Army Deploys in Zawtar al-Gharbiyeh Following Israeli Withdrawal
timeline.summary: The Lebanese army has begun deploying troops in the southern town of Zawtar al-Gharbiyeh after Israeli forces withdrew from the area. This move aligns with a U.S.-brokered plan, according to a senior Lebanese security official.
key_facts: Lebanese army troops are deploying in Zawtar al-Gharbiyeh.
Israeli forces have withdrawn from the area.
The deployment is part of a U.S.-brokered plan.
